execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (ratified -- see DR-005, issue #1)' row 'Iq' (< 50 uA), for the 3.3 V primary flavor (DR-001). Measures the total current out of the single supply source feeding the ROUTED, LVS-clean bandgap-core layout (issue #62) -- both core branches, the R2A/R2B legs and the error amplifier's mirrored tail, now including the drawn VDD/VSS routing's own series resistance -- open-circuit at VREF, over the full 45-point PVT matrix, via klt extract --parasitics translated to a simulatable netlist (sim/bin/post_layout_common.py) -- NOT design/bandgap_core.sch directly; see 'Netlist provenance' below.
experiment.provenance_source: layout/bandgap-core/reports/20260923-070209-dbd57a9/bandgap_core_routed.gds via `klt extract --parasitics` (layout record 20260923-070209-dbd57a9), translated by sim/bin/post_layout_common.py, wrapped over the unmodified sim/quiescent-current/testbench/tb_vref_iq.sch
experiment.title: Total quiescent supply current of the untrimmed core over the full PVT matrix -- POST-LAYOUT (extracted netlist)

spread_checks.note: Iq must move by at least 1 uA across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat current would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator -- the same liveness argument sim/pdk-smoke/ makes for the harness itself.

tools.ngspice: ngspice-46 (remote, batch fleet None; not the dispatch host's ngspice)
